summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only testing of MP Industries static React landing page (Home, Products, About, Contact, 404). All critical flows, data-testids, SEO, public files, modals, search/filter, WhatsApp inquiry, navigation, accessibility and animations verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: InquiryModal overlay is a sibling div under role=dialog; clicking overlay at viewport center hits the dialog content (sibling) area and won't dismiss — this is correct behavior (user clicks outside the dialog box) but Playwright's default center-click on the overlay element will fail. Not a real bug, but worth noting for future test scripts.

Mobile drawer stays mounted and uses CSS translate to hide — Playwright is_visible() returns true even when off-screen. Functionally correct (animation), but tests need to use class/translate attribute or aria-expanded for hidden assertion.

Floating WhatsApp button has continuous pulse animation which makes Playwright .hover() flaky (element-not-stable). Consider pausing animation when prefers-reduced-motion or using aria-label-only tooltip (already done — aria-label present).
seed_data_creation: None — static site with hardcoded products data (69 products confirmed in /app/frontend/src/data/products.js).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified items (all PASS): (1) Home: hero text 'Built for the machines that build India.', stats animate to 20+/69+ when scrolled into view, world map with 3 highlighted regions, catalog teaser with 4 cards (4 inquire btns), CTA block, JSON-LD with @graph containing Organization + LocalBusiness, SEO meta (title/desc/canonical/og/twitter). (2) Navbar: all 4 links + Get Quote CTA, active link highlights in #D05030, mobile hamburger toggles drawer (drawer uses CSS translate so always 'visible' to is_visible — verify via class/translate). (3) Footer: dark bg, both phones, email info@mpindustries.in, Ahmedabad address, 'Since 2004', green WhatsApp button, copyright year 2026 visible. (4) FloatingWhatsApp: href=https://wa.me/919824155389?text=..., target=_blank, aria-label='Chat with MP Industries on WhatsApp', visible tooltip text 'Chat with us', has pulse animation. (5) BackToTop: hidden initially, appears after scroll>300, clicks smooth-scroll to scrollY=0. (6) Products: 69 cards, count text 'Showing 69 of 69 products', search 'gear' filters correctly, 'Drums' chip filters, 'All Products' resets, no-results state with WhatsApp fallback shown for 'zzzzz999' query. (7) InquiryModal: aria-modal=true, opens/closes correctly, empty submit shows inline name+phone errors, valid submit opens wa.me/919824155389 URL with EXACT message 'Hi MP Industries! I am interested in {product}. My name is {name} and my contact number is {phone}. Please share more details.' + ' I also need a custom part specification.' when checkbox is checked, ESC closes modal, X button closes, overlay click closes (when clicked at coords outside dialog body). Modal traps focus. (8) About: 'Our Story', 'What We Make', 'Who We Serve', 'Our Reach', 'Why Trust' sections all visible; 4 serve cards (Mixer Manufacturers, OEM Suppliers, Construction Contractors, International Buyers). (9) Contact: both tel: links (tel:+919824155389, tel:+919824155380), WhatsApp btn, mailto:info@mpindustries.in, address, Google Maps iframe (inside contact-map div) with valid embed URL. (10) Routing: /, /products, /about, /contact all route correctly; /this-does-not-exist shows NotFound page with 404-home-btn and 404-products-btn visible. (11) Public files: /robots.txt (200, User-agent + Sitemap), /sitemap.xml (200, 4 <loc> URLs), /favicon.svg (200). (12) Skip-to-main with href=#main targets element with id=main and data-testid=main-content. (13) Reduced motion CSS rule present in stylesheets. (14) Zero console errors across all pages.
rca of the issue: No issues found. App is production-ready as per spec.
